body:
## User-authorized DM-454 failure investigation and decomposition

Original rev3 implementation remains rejected; no production link code was accepted or merged. Three independent source-backed reviews agree this was an over-combined boundary problem, not evidence that per-ticket full gates or mandatory tests-first were missing.

### Actual failure sequence
1. Attempt1 /3e01553: output retired callbacks while installed xterm retained same-row provider/current-link cache; producer imageReference JSON escaping changed filesystem identity when only quotes were stripped; delayed imageA could overwrite newer fileB in the same Viewer because physical pane ownership did not change.
2. Attempt2 /df99871 repaired those issues but revived local links from path/range equality. Rewriting identical text under HTTP OSC8 changed metadata/ownership, not path/range; the previously empty higher-priority OSC8 reply stayed cached and local image navigation shadowed its URI.
3. Attempt3 /4c811106 removed local revival and demanded full-provider redispatch, but refreshImageRows (rejected xtermKit.ts210–215) clips rendering to visible rows. Installed node_modules/@xterm/xterm/src/browser/Linkifier.ts306–318 requires the ENTIRE returned range inside rendered interval. ImagePathLinks.ts253–265 still returns full wrapped-token range. If visible rows101–103 show a path ending104, 104<=103 is false even after whole-viewport refresh. RenderService clamps to viewport. The callback is retired, same-row re-entry reuses the cache, and coalescing prevents another useful dispatch; removing coalescing alone cannot solve impossible containment. This remains unresolved.

### Why the passing evidence missed it
Geometry tests directly called provideLinks for wrapped/scrollback paths; real installed-Linkifier fixture used a short fully visible first-row path and first-row mouse coordinates. Their composition—scrolled partial-wrap + output retirement + stationary/same-row pointer + fresh all-provider arbitration—was absent. Native positive-control screenshots proved exercised cases, not all wrapped viewport behavior. Accepted Activity/capture UI was added while rejected link code stayed separate; synthetic invalidateNavigation buttons do not prove those actual entrypoints supersede delayed image activation.

### Preserve, do not recopy blindly
Rejected branch contains valuable producer/raw-path and synchronous navigation repairs, but none is accepted in hybrid-s1. Selectively port onto accepted4ad1019, preserving real parser/onRender capture readiness, synchronized-output/disposal fences, whole-window consent, one geometry reporter, independent overlay leases, activity/correlation inspection without starting a terminal and the capture thumbnail flow.

### Bounded recovery contracts
A. Path mapper: full decoded identity remains independent of displayed escaped spelling; offer requested-row refreshable presentation ranges using actual mapped cells, excluding quotes/wide padding/partial graphemes. Preserve64KiB/traversal bounds and URL rejection.
B. xterm lifecycle: only fresh complete provider arbitration can restore authority. Add actual installed-Linkifier partial-viewport/cache/OSC8 tests through production writes/render/mouse events; never manually query providers to fake recovery, patch vendor cache or revive by local equality. Compose with accepted capture parser/render barriers and one emulator lifetime.
C. Workspace: physical PTY/pane epoch is not user navigation intent. All real file/Viewer, Activity agent/transcript, capture-open and same-chat correlation entrypoints supersede older intents synchronously before React scheduling. Explicit file opens clear transient Activity projection even same saved path, validate intent before own invalidation, and merge with synchronously latest layout. Paging/geometry/ordinary chat reloads are not new file intents. Checked main acquisition/capabilities and per-owner overlay cleanup stay authoritative.

### Replan and honesty
User now authorizes a second sprint. Standard redraft moved DM454 and dependent docs460; DM454 becomes review/finalization of this analysis and contracts, with three separate required implementation tickets in Sprint2. Original three attempts remain rejected/history; no completion state copied. src/core/services/adoptionFreshBudget.test.ts171–177 proves same-sprint retitling does NOT restore retries; moving to a later sprint on adoption supersedes spent attempts and grants that sprint a fresh budget. Parent ran all18 existing adoption-budget tests successfully in isolated test contexts, not against project state.

Sprint1: independently verify the13accepted core work items, their current integrated witness and all six project DoD checks; no image-link/full-product claim. Sprint2: complete mapped links/cache/UI and docs, then retain the entire original final runtime/platform/provider/security/latency/CLI/MCP/packaged quality matrix. Missing external prerequisites stay unmet gates. Neither sprint is already accepted, no human approval is supplied, and adoption/checkpoint progression remain explicit process steps.

Independent read-only reviewers: LinkFailureMechanisms and LinkFailureScopeAudit; actual sources inspected at rejected4c811106 and accepted4ad1019. No new production code, vendor startup, native focus change, status acceptance, retry grant or DB edit in this investigation.
